item.title: Handel's Messiah - Lausanne Cathedral 2025 (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.12.2025)
item.description:
As part of the celebrations marking the 750th anniversary of Lausanne Cathedral, Hans-Christoph Rademann conducts a monumental work of sacred music: Georg Friedrich Handel's Messiah, first performed in 1741.
From 01.12.2025 16:00

item.title: Christmas@Home 2022 - Daniel Hope, Sting and Guests (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.11.2025)
item.description:
In a special Christmas edition, violinist Daniel Hope and guests perform a varied and atmospheric repertoire including traditional Christmas songs in new arrangements, classical works and the hit song "Fields of Gold".Daniel Hope's guests are British musician, composer, and living-legend, Sting, Canadian pianist Bruce Liu, winner of the 18th International Chopin Piano Competition, South African s.....
From 12.11.2025 05:00

item.title: Martha Argerich Plays Prokofiev (11.06.2021)
item.description:
Star Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Prokofiev’s third piano concerto with the  French Radio Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of conductor Myung-Whun Chung. Also on the programme is Prokofiev’s Ballet Suites from Rome and Juliet.
From 11.06.2021 17:00

item.title: Mozart at the Hotel Sully (Paris) (05.02.2021)
item.description:
On a summer’s eve renowned pianist and conductor Lars Vogt leads the orchestre de chambre de Paris in a performance of Mozart’s much-loved Piano Concerto No. 9.
From 05.02.2021 00:00

item.title: "L'Opera Seria" - Teatro alla Scala Milan (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.12.2025)
item.description:
In search of an opera for his theatre, an impresario finds himself grappling with a group of egotists and jealous individuals. Based on a score by Florian Leopold Gassmann, this caustic satire of the 18th-century opera world is directed by Laurent Pelly. Starring Julie Fuchs as the prima donna. 
From 30.12.2025 23:52

item.title: Gustave Charpentier: Louise - Festival d'Aix-en-Provence (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.07.2025)
item.description:
Escaping from her stifling working-class family, the young Louise joins her penniless lover Julien in Paris. But disillusionment will soon set in... Christof Loy’s new reading of Gustave Charpentier’s opera is brought to life by soprano Elsa Dreisig.During the presenter Saskia de Ville’s introduction, third-person subtitles allow non-French-speaking viewers to follow her presentation. De Ville c.....
From 12.07.2025 22:47

item.title: Monteverdi: L’incoronazione di Poppea - Gran Teatre del Liceu, Barcelona (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.11.2024)
item.description:
Love, power and ambition collide on the stage of Barcelona’s Teatre de Liceu in Monteverdi’s L’incoronazione di Poppea, directed by Calixto Bieito.
From 13.11.2024 09:52

item.title: Gioachino Rossini: William Tell - Opéra de Lausanne (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.11.2025)
item.description:
Gessler’s hat became a metaphor for enforced submissive behaviour. When William Tell refuses to salute the tyrannical Governor’s hat, his punishment is to put his son’s life in danger. Rossini’s opera, based on Friedrich Schiller’s play, is performed in Lausanne for the first time. With Jean-Sébastien Bou in the title role and Luigi De Donato in that of the Governor.
From 23.11.2025 05:00

item.title: Francesco Cilea: Adriana Lecouvreur - Latvian National Opera, Riga (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.07.2025)
item.description:
“Adriana Lecouvreur”, Calabrian composer Francesco Cilea’s most famous work, is a lyrical retelling of the story of Adrienne Lecouvreur, the famous Parisian actress who died in suspicious circumstances in 1730.
From 27.07.2025 05:00

item.title: Sergei Prokofiev: The Fiery Angel - Teatro Real, Madrid (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.02.2025)
item.description:
Live from the Teatro Real in Madrid, an adaptation of Prokofiev’s flamboyant masterpiece by the ever-radical Calixto Bieito
From 02.02.2025 05:00

item.title: Gaetano Donizetti: Maria Stuarda - Teatro Real, Madrid (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.05.2025)
item.description:
A masterpiece of bel canto at the Teatro Real in Madrid: conductor José Miguel Pérez-Sierra and director David McVicar take on Donizetti’s Maria Stuarda, with Lisette Oropesa in the title role.
From 05.05.2025 05:00

item.title: Jean-Philippe Rameau: Platée - Czech National Theatre, Prague (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.09.2025)
item.description:
Platée, a silly and conceited nymph, falls for a fake wedding to Jupiter, king of the gods. This new staging of Jean-Philippe Rameau’s Baroque masterpiece is colourful, eccentric, full of wit and free of taboos, yet also surprisingly deep.
From 23.09.2025 14:00

item.title: Richard Strauss: Der Rosenkavalier - Zurich Opera House (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.09.2025)
item.description:
Set in an imaginary Rococo Vienna, Der Rosenkavalier by Richard Strauss and Hugo von Hofmannsthal is a social comedy of great depth and charm. Realising that her young lover has fallen head over heels in love on presenting the bride-to-be of Baron Ochs von Lerchenau with a silver rose betokening their betrothal, the gracious Marschallin lets him go- though not without sighs of regret.
From 22.09.2025 16:30

item.title: "The Silent Woman" by Richard Strauss - Berlin State Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.10.2025)
item.description:
Ageing misfit Sir Morosus lives alone in an old-style apartment in Charlottenburg in Berlin. He is wealthy, but also lonely and a bit grumpy. Then his nephew Henry moves in with him and his life takes a turn for the better. Director Jan Philipp Gloger homes in on two of the most pressing problems of the day: loneliness and the housing shortage. The Staatskapelle Berlin is conducted by Christian Th.....
From 16.10.2025 05:00

item.title: Alexander Rodin: Kateryna - A premiere by Odessa Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.01.2025)
item.description:
To mark the anniversary of the war, ARTE Concert is screening Kateryna, a Ukrainian opera by Alexander Rodin, commissioned by Odessa Opera. Kateryna premiered at the Odessa opera house in September 2022, despite the Russian war of aggression. The premiere had originally been planned to coincide with World Theater Day on 27 March 2022.
From 08.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Georg Friedrich Handel: Giulio Cesare - At the Dutch National Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.03.2024)
item.description:
In Amsterdam, conductor Emmanuelle Haïm and director Calixto Bieito take on Handel’s famous Giulio Cesare.
From 13.03.2024 15:33

item.title: Giuseppe Verdi: La Traviata - Grand Théâtre de Genève (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.11.2025)
item.description:
Taking a classic opera and turning it on its head, Karin Henkel, a leading director in contemporary German theatre, offers a new interpretation of Verdi's masterpiece. In a world dominated by men, where women are exploited and history repeats itself, she explores the fate and sacrifice of a 19th-century heroine through a contemporary female perspective.
From 01.11.2025 05:00

item.title: "Dalibor" by Bedřich Smetana - At the Czech National Theatre (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.11.2021)
item.description:
As part of the ARTE Opera Season, the Czech National Theatre is showing a classic from the Czech repertoire: In this opera, Bedřich Smetana tells the story of an avenger figure from Czech history, whom he elevates to the rank of national hero. The opera is conducted by Jaroslav Kyzlink while Jiří Nekvasil signs the stage direction.
From 23.11.2021 05:01

item.title: Rossini: Il Barbiere di Siviglia - From the Vienna State Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.11.2021)
item.description:
Rossini’s Il Barbiere di Siviglia ranks among the most popular and most successful works in the entire operatic canon. For his new staging of the work at the Vienna State Opera the director, actor and media artist Herbert Fritsch has assembled a star-studded cast that includes Juan Diego Flórez in the role of Count Almaviva, Ildar Abdrazakov as Don Basilio, Vasilisa Berzhanskaya as Rosina and Étie.....
From 27.11.2021 05:00

item.title: Richard Strauss: Salome - Directed by Christof Loy in Helsinki (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.03.2024)
item.description:
The literary source for Richard Strauss’s opera immortalizing the degeneracy of Herodes Antipas, King of Judea, and his step-daughter Salome, was supplied by Oscar Wilde. It tells of Herodes, who is keeping the prophet Jochanaan captive inside a cistern. Salome tries to seduce him and on being rebuffed, forces her stepfather to serve her the prophet’s head on a silver platter.
From 03.03.2024 05:00

item.title: Richard Strauss: Salome - Staatsoper Hamburg (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.01.2025)
item.description:
Dmitri Tcherniakov’s remarkable new staging of Richard Strauss’s Salome tells a very dark tale. Asmik Grigorian shines in the title role of Salome, whose craving for autonomy and revenge takes a fateful turn. Streamed live on ARTE Concert, this performance of the opera from the Staatsoper Hamburg under the baton Kent Nagano promises to be thrilling theatre.
From 05.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Giacomo Puccini: Madama Butterfly - Festival d'Aix-en-Provence (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.06.2025)
item.description:
Seduced by a visiting American soldier, the geisha Cio-Cio-San, known as Madama Butterfly, awaits his return... In a production by Andrea Breth and under the musical direction of Daniele Rustioni, the Albanian soprano Ermonela Jaho brings Puccini's Japanese tragedy to life at the Théâtre de l'Archevêché in Aix-en-Provence.
From 04.06.2025 10:07

item.title: Rameau: Hippolyte et Aricie - At the Opéra Comique in Paris (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.02.2022)
item.description:
In October 1733, the audience at the Académie Royale de Musique witnessed the birth of a revolutionary work: Hippolyte et Aricie. With its inventiveness and musical richness, Rameau’s opera marks a break in the history of French music. A similarly revolutionary duo – Jeanne Candel and Raphaël Pichon – get to grips with this work for the Opéra Comique.
From 01.02.2022 14:06

item.title: Sergei Prokofiev: War and Peace - Bavarian State Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.10.2023)
item.description:
Director Dmitri Tcherniakov and conductor Vladimir Jurowski deliver a breathtaking version of Sergei Prokofiev's monumental opera at the Munich Opera House. 
From 08.10.2023 05:00

item.title: Leevi Madetoja: The Ostrobothnians - Finnish National Opera Helsinki (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.01.2025)
item.description:
Finland may be the happiest country on earth, but it is also known as the land of a thousand sad songs. Lurking in the shadows of this Nordic welfare state are violence, alcoholism and inequality. A century after its premiere, the most Finnish of all operas is now being performed in a new production at the Helsinki Opera House.
From 13.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Circus of Tomorrow (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.12.2024)
item.description:
Filmed from the beguiling Musée des Arts Forains in Paris, this exceptional show brings together former winners of the Festival Mondial du Cirque de demain for a special spectacle.
From 19.12.2024 05:00

item.title: Ground Control - The Stranglers, The Jesus and Mary Chain, Keren Ann & Quatuor Debussy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.01.2025)
item.description:
In a disused Paris railway depot Christophe Cassel hosts two legendary British bands that are still going strong: The Stranglers and The Jesus and Mary Chain. They are joined by Keren Ann accompanied by her string quartet and the Australian whistler, Molly Lewis.
From 18.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Berlin Live: Boy George & Culture Club (16.12.2021)
item.description:
For many, Culture Club epitomised 1980s pop music with global hits such as ‘Do You Really Want to Hurt Me?’ and ‘Karma Chameleon’. They take to the Berlin Live stage as part of an international tour promoting their new album ‘Life’.
From 16.12.2021 05:00

item.title: Sébastien Tellier - ARTE Concert Festival (19.01.2021)
item.description:
Sébastien Tellier is a singular artist with multiple facets: Darling of the Paris electro scene since the turn of the century and yet able to represent France at the kitsch fest of the Eurovison song contest in 2008. Performing at the ARTE Concert Festival on November 13 2020 at the release of his latest album ‘Simple Minds’.
From 19.01.2021 14:40

item.title: Neville Brothers - "Tell it like this" (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.04.2025)
item.description:
The emblematic New Orleans soul band, play with a host of guests in a festive concert filmed in 1989.
From 19.04.2025 05:00

item.title: Morcheeba - Berlin Live (18.11.2021)
item.description:
London group Morcheeba have been going strong for 25 years with their unique chilled sound, most famously on their much celebrated 1998 album Big Calm. In 2018 they took to the Berlin stage to perform from their ninth album Blaze Away
From 18.11.2021 11:05

item.title: Gretel Hänlyn - Echoes with Jehnny Beth (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.10.2024)
item.description:
British singer Gretel Hänlyn takes the stage for the first time in Paris for Echoes with Jehnny Beth.
From 08.10.2024 05:00

item.title: Cigarettes After Sex in Private Paris Concert (23.11.2020)
item.description:
In a special private concert in Paris, Greg Gonzales and his band perform from their newly released second album, ‘Cry’.
From 23.11.2020 18:15

item.title: Sparks At the Château d'Hérouville (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.07.2024)
item.description:
Sparks, the legendary Californian band with 25 albums, invites you to the Château d'Hérouville, France's famous studio in the countryside where many of rock and pop greats have recorded over the years.. The duo tell their story and play their greatest hits live such as  "This Town Ain't Big Enough for Both of Us" to "My Baby's Taking Me Home" and "So May We Start".
From 03.07.2024 05:00

item.title: Bastille - Sounds Like Art - Turner Contemporary Museum in Margate (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.03.2025)
item.description:
Sounds Like Art invites musicians to play in the midst of works of art in a European museum. In this edition, British pop group Bastille present their new album & at the Turner Contemporary Museum in Margate on the English coast. Lead singer Dan Smith says he is particularly interested in the art of Anya Gallaccio and Antony Gormley.
From 11.03.2025 05:00

item.title: Sounds Like Art - Gossip - Neue Nationalgalerie Berlin (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.08.2025)
item.description:
ARTE welcomes international artists to some of the best art collections in Europe. American group Gossip, led by the charismatic singer Beth Ditto, engages in a dialogue with works by Lucy Raven and Yoko Ono at Berlin’s Neue Nationalgalerie.
From 13.08.2025 05:00

item.title: In Conversation with Juliette Binoche (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.12.2025)
item.description:
Juliette Binoche talks widely on her impressive and varied career as an actress in romantic films, comedies, period pieces and intense dramas. She also speaks about working with great directors such as Abbas Kiarostami and Michael Haneke, as well a new generation of French filmmakers.
From 04.12.2025 13:16

item.title: A Conversation with Lucile Hadzihalilovic (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.05.2025)
item.description:
Filmmaker Lucile Hadzilalilovic, winner of the Silver Bear at the 2025 Berlinale for “The Tower of Ice”, delves into her world of hauntingly beautiful tales. From “Innocence” to her latest film, she crafts stories rich in mystery, where powerful women and enigmatic youth evoke the legacy of Argento-style genre cinema.
From 07.05.2025 16:50

item.title: In Conversation with Michael Haneke (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2024)
item.description:
Michael Haneke retraces his career and talks about the first films he made for television, but also how they differ from his later films intended for a cinema audience.
From 02.12.2024 09:58

item.title: A Conversation with Rebecca Zlotowski (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.12.2024)
item.description:
For Rebecca Zlotowski, being a filmmaker today is all about taking an intimate look at the world. As a screenwriter and director, she makes films by infusing her personal obsessions with major social movements. Zlotowski’s work is imbued with poetry, charm and a paradoxical mystery between a pragmatic and mysterious view of life.
From 06.12.2024 12:00

item.title: A Conversation with Hafsia Herzi (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (28.05.2025)
item.description:
Hafsia Herzi rose to fame when she starred in Abdelatif Kechiche’s film “The Secret of the Grain”. But the actress is also passionate about directing, which is simply another way for her to express herself. In a handful of films that explore the value of community, Herzi speaks about how the conventions of cinema can reveal a contagious force.
From 28.05.2025 18:50

item.title: In Conversation with François Ozon (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.12.2024)
item.description:
François Ozon navigates diverse genres, from tragedies to popular comedies and enigmatic tales. With curiosity and a playful approach, he deciphers the unknowns of life through his films, crafting stories that reveal his unique cinematic voice.
From 09.12.2024 10:43

item.title: Conversation with Robert Guédiguian (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.03.2024)
item.description:
Before becoming a filmmaker, Robert Guédiguian always thought he would be an activist who lived intensely. His cinema is like him: From Marseille, expansive and joyful, poetic and above all, human.
From 15.03.2024 18:30

item.title: In Conversation with Mia Hansen-Løve (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)
item.description:
Mia Hansen-Løve describes her love for the cathartic and emancipatory dimension of cinema. From her early films, the intimate and the personal unfold with sincerity and a minimalistic aesthetic. "Bergman Island" is in competition this year at Cannes.
From 27.12.2023 14:08

item.title: In Conversation with Justine Triet (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)
item.description:
The 2023 Palme d'Or winner "Anatomy of a Fall" directed by Justine Triet is now showing in theatres. We revisit the filmmaker's distinctive and lively style. Triet is known for her remarkable feminist portraits. Her films "Age of Panic", "Victoria" and "Sibyl" form a turbulent body of work depicting contemporaryand urban France.
From 27.12.2023 14:06

item.title: A Conversation with Walter Salles (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.01.2025)
item.description:
Walter Salles, a former documentary filmmaker, is deeply inspired by Brazil’s history. His films vividly depict the country’s social and political realities, intertwining past and present. Central to his storytelling are the perspectives of people in a society shaped by the absence of fathers, both figuratively and literally – offering a poignant view of Brazilian identity.
From 29.01.2025 11:00

item.title: A Conversation with Marion Cotillard (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2025)
item.description:
How has French actress Marion Cotillard embodied characters from all walks of life with such passion and strength? Through an intense practice of her craft, driven by a secret desire to understand the human soul.
From 20.06.2025 15:55

item.title: A Conversation with Emmanuel Mouret (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.05.2025)
item.description:
Emmanuel Mouret has crafted a unique cinematic voice, blending comedy, drama and emotion. His films follow strong-willed characters navigating love and heartache with tenderness. Through precise, sensory writing, Mouret explores the delicate balance between burlesque and genuine human vulnerability.
From 01.05.2025 09:00

item.title: In Conversation with Louis Garrel (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2024)
item.description:
Louis Garrel, actor and filmmaker, discusses "The Innocent", where he merges his love for introspective drama and playful humor. From starring in his father Philippe Garrel’s art films to embodying the King of France in "The Three Musketeers", Garrel has navigated diverse genres. In this interview, he reveals how "The Innocent" became the ultimate synthesis of his cinematic dreams.
From 02.12.2024 09:55

item.title: Remember to Blink (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.01.2026)
item.description:
When a French couple adopts two Lithuanian children, they invite Gabriele, a young Lithuanian student, to live with them as an interpreter and help the children adjust. In their idyllic mountain home, subtle cultural clashes and power struggles emerge between parents and translator, love and control, exposing the fragile balance beneath the façade of a perfect family.
From 04.01.2026 11:41

item.title: The Mark of the Day (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.12.2025)
item.description:
In the Lens basin at the start of the 20th century, the film follows the hopes and hardships of a tight-knit mining community. With a socially conscious, realist eye, Louis Daquin portrays the daily grit of northern France’s coal workers and the rising tension between a young engineer and his entrenched superior.
From 16.12.2025 11:39

item.title: Lissy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.10.2025)
item.description:
Berlin, early 1930s. Lissy, a working-class woman, hopes for stability when she marries Alfred, a clerk with modest ambitions. But after he is fired from his job, Alfred turns to the rising Nazi movement, seduced by promises and power. When Lissy’s communist brother is killed by the SA, she is forced to confront the truth about the regime, as well as her place beside the man she loves.
From 20.10.2025 05:00

item.title: Forever-Forever (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.11.2025)
item.description:
Kyiv, late 1990s. Tonia transfers schools to escape violence only to find herself drawn into a restless group of teenagers testing the limits of love, friendship and cruelty. Between first desires and reckless games, she falls for the charismatic Zhurik while longing for Sania, caught in a swirl of emotions where innocence and danger intertwine. No one escapes unscathed.
From 05.11.2025 09:42

item.title: Mataharis (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.09.2025)
item.description:
Inés, Eva and Carmen are private detectives in Madrid, trained to uncover the secrets of others. But as their investigations deepen, each woman must confront hidden truths in her own life – testing the boundaries between their jobs and intimate spheres.
From 01.09.2025 05:00

item.title: The Red Squirrel (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.09.2025)
item.description:
On the verge of suicide, Jota witnesses a motorcycle crash and discovers the rider, Lisa, has lost her memory. Seizing the moment, he claims to be her longtime lover and invents a past for them both. But as they retreat to a secluded campsite called The Red Squirrel, cracks appear in Jota’s story, and Lisa may not be as lost as she seems.
From 01.09.2025 05:00

item.title: Victim (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.11.2025)
item.description:
Irina, a Ukrainian single mother, lives with her 13-year-old son Igor in a small Czech border town. One night, Igor is violently beaten. When he regains consciousness, he claims the attackers were Roma. As the town’s outrage grows, Irina begins to notice inconsistencies in his story. Her search for the truth reveals the fault lines of prejudice that run through the community.
From 05.11.2025 09:49

item.title: The Night of the Plastic Bags (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.05.2025)
item.description:
Agathe is 39 and is desperate to have a baby. She goes to see her ex who is DJing at a party to try and convince him to have a child with her. But a strange phenomenon happens: Plastic bags come to life and take over the city of Marseille…
From 09.05.2025 05:00

item.title: Blood Wedding (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.09.2025)
item.description:
In a threadbare rehearsal space, a Spanish flamenco troupe gathers to stage Federico Garcia Lorca's play “Blood Wedding”. Through striking choreography and music, they evoke a story of forbidden passion, betrayal and revenge. A haunting meditation on ritual and the emotional power of dance.
From 01.09.2025 05:00

item.title: Journey to Italy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.11.2025)
item.description:
An English couple travels to Italy. After their arrival in Naples, cracks start to show in their relationship. This film is one of Roberto Rossellini's best works, which inspired a generation of French New Wave filmmakers. The couple is played by Ingrid Bergman, who made four other films with Rossellini, and George Sanders.
From 01.11.2025 05:00

item.title: Stars (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.10.2025)
item.description:
Stationed in a remote Bulgarian village in 1943, German sergeant Walter lives seemingly untouched by the war until a convoy of Greek Jews on its way to Auschwitz arrives. That is how he meets Ruth, a young Jewish woman whose courage awakens his conscience. As love grows between prisoner and guard, Walter faces a devastating choice between duty and humanity in the shadow of fascism.
From 20.10.2025 05:00

item.title: Rome, Open City (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.10.2025)
item.description:
An Italian resistance leader, Giorgio Manfredi, hides from Nazis with a widow, a priest, and his friend's help. Though Rome is an open city, daily life is tough under occupation. Pina, a pregnant widow, plans to marry Francesco, aided by the fearless priest Don Pietro. Tension rises as Giorgio's mission intertwines with their lives, leading to a gripping tale of bravery and sacrifice.
From 01.10.2025 05:00

item.title: Sad Jokes (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.11.2025)
item.description:
Joseph and Sonya are close friends raising their young son Pino together. While Joseph, a filmmaker, works on a new project and struggles to come to terms with his break-up with Marc, Sonya gradually sinks into depression. When she is hospitalised, Joseph is forced to juggle family life with his artistic ambitions.  
From 12.11.2025 16:51

item.title: Matador (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.09.2025)
item.description:
In Pedro Almodóvar’s erotic and macabre fable, a once-great matador who can no longer fight crosses paths with a seductive murderess and a troubled young man. As desire, obsession, and violence intertwine – the film explores passion’s deadly edge in a twisted tale of love and death.
From 01.09.2025 05:00

item.title: Tailor (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.11.2025)
item.description:
When the bank threatens to seize his family’s shop and his father falls ill, Nikos, the eccentric tailor, refuses to give up. Turning his artistry and imagination into action, he builds a shop on wheels – bringing style and confidence to the women of Athens. Along the way, he rediscovers love, creativity and slowly stitches his life back together.
From 06.11.2025 10:53

item.title: Solo Sunny (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.10.2025)
item.description:
Sunny, a pop singer touring small East German towns with a mediocre band, feels increasingly trapped by routine and loneliness. When she begins an affair with Ralph, a saxophonist and philosopher obsessed with death, she hopes for change but finds no escape. After being expelled from the band, Sunny must face herself and her desire for a life beyond conformity in a society that leaves little room .....
From 20.10.2025 05:00

item.title: Common Wealth (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.09.2025)
item.description:
In a crumbling Madrid apartment block, estate agent Julia discovers a hidden fortune in a deceased tenant’s flat. Tempted by dreams of escape and luxury, she soon learns she’s not the only one with eyes on the money. Álex de la Iglesia crafts a tense and dark comic thriller where greed, paranoia and neighbourly menace bubble just beneath the surface.
From 01.09.2025 05:00

item.title: Intacto (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.09.2025)
item.description:
In a shadowy world where luck is real and transferable, Federico seeks revenge against the man who once stole everything from him. He discovers Tomás, a young thief and sole survivor of a plane crash, and sees in him the power to challenge fate itself. As the two descend into an underground network of high-stakes games, they risk everything to outplay destiny.
From 01.09.2025 05:00

item.title: Divided Heaven (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.10.2025)
item.description:
Rita Seidel, a young student, falls in love with Manfred Herrfurth, an older chemist. When Manfred escapes to West Berlin before the construction of the wall, Rita must decide between love and conviction in a changing East Germany. The film marks a turning point in East German cinema and is praised by critics as one of the most important films in German history.

Although "kinky" images are present in our collective imagination, enthusiasts of specific sexual practices have taken a long time to embrace their preferences. Through art and spaces where kink is celebrated, the community now normalises practices that were once considered perverse. Kink fans are experiencing their coming-out and openly embracing their preferences.

item.description:
Behind the dangerous and illegal urban rodeos lies a discipline that influences pop culture, from rap videos to movies. Tracks explores this subculture and sport, from Bike life and motorcycle acrobatics to intense clandestine carmeets.

item.title: Tracks - Georgia's Queer Scene (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.09.2024)
item.description:
Georgia hosts the only Pride march in the Caucasus region. In this country, where homosexuality was a crime until 2000, the pro-Russian government equates LGBT struggles with Western propaganda. Against a backdrop of high tension and open discrimination, the Queer artistic community In Tbilisi is resisting.
From 20.09.2024 11:16

item.title: Tracks - The Voice of AI (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)
item.description:

item.description:

But if our sexuality is shaped by algorithms, can’t we take back some control? The post-porn movement is doing exactly that. Aimed at creating pornography that reflects honest, consensual sex – its creators are making waves online.

item.title: Unhappy - Happiness and Friendship (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.12.2023)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Granfluencers on Tiktok (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.04.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Unhappy - Happiness and Habitat (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.11.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Unhappy - Of Men and Horses (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:
Can regular contact with animals make us happier? Ronja von Rönne meets two people who are passionate about animals.

item.description:

item.description:
The world of work is out of balance. Essential jobs are undervalued while "bullshit jobs" like happiness managers or managers of managers thrive. In this absurd reality, do artists have the power to challenge the status quo? Tracks went to visit two satirical art projects to dig deeper into the true worth of work.

item.title: The Book of My Life - With Yuval Noah Harari (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2025)
item.description:

item.description:
Neoperreo is an alternative subgenre of reggaeton, a musical genre often criticised for its macho sexism. Created in Chile by women and the queer community, this movement hijacks reggaeton’s highly sexualised sound for queer liberation.

item.title: Tracks - Amapiano: The Sound of South Africa (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.04.2024)
item.description:

item.description:
Young women in Japan rebelled against a conformist, monochrome society in the 1990s with the gyaru style: Outrageous clothes and make-up that rejected the cult of paleness prevalent in Japanese society. item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Unhappy - Running and Hiking (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Science Fiction Revolution - Space and Time (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.12.2025)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:
On the world map one continent is missing…. Made up of servers, cables, and virtual interaction. It is an invisible land, yet it is where we now live. item.description:

item.title: Stand Up - A Passion for Laught - Women Aren't Funny (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.12.2024)

But things are changing: More women are taking to the stage and their humour is tackling age-old taboos.

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Stand Up - A Passion for Laughter - Minority Battles (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.12.2024)
item.description:
This documentary looks at the history of stand up and why the punchline professionals are so popular. Episode 3: Stand up has become a way for minorities to fight back against dominant discourses. But when comiedians get political, do they lose their sense of humour?

item.title: Tracks Inside - Techno & TikTok (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Upcycling: Fashion Punks against Fast Fashion (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.05.2025)
item.description:

Since the 1990s, JJ Hudson, alias Dr Noki, a figure of the London underground, has been transforming used clothes into wearable works of art, hijacking logos and brands to strip them of their advertising power. In Paris, Lamine Badian Kouyaté, founder of Xüly Bët, deconstruct.....
From 09.05.2025 17:37

item.title: Black Surfers Matter - The N Word (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.07.2024)
item.description:
Surfing reflects wider racial problems that persist in the United States: many black surfers prefer to surf at night to avoid being harassed as segregation still casts a shadow over the beaches of California.

item.title: Tracks East - Protests, Parties, Death (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.03.2024)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

In the face of her enforced silence, her fans took over and brought her into virtual existence, appropriating her image. How has social media allowed fans to reverse the balance of power between the media and the public?

item.title: Tracks - Stihia: Techno Festival in the Uzbek Desert (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.08.2025)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: 42: The Answer to Almost Everything - Do We Need Corruption? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2024)
item.description:

item.title: The World in Images - Baltic States: Going Off-Grid (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.03.2025)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

China, the Netherlands and small island nations of the South Pacific are especially at risk. How can coastal communities adapt to the threat of rising sea levels?

item.description:

Prum is convinced that "the complexity of aesthetic and sexual pleasure" in.....
